headline: Beegarde gatherer
title: Beegarde | Gathering And Farming Worker | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need a good gatherer? Beegarde spawns around Verdant Brook in Palworld one point zero, roughly level twenty eight to thirty three. At your base it works Gathering level three and Farming level three, with Planting, Handiwork, Lumbering, Medicine and Transporting at level two. Its partner skill, Worker Bee, also boosts Elizabee's attack. Will you use Beegarde? Comment below!
description: Beegarde in Palworld 1.0: found around Verdant Brook at about level 28 to 33, a strong Gathering 3 and Farming 3 base worker.
